en: A multiview color postcard featuring landmarks of Sibiu: central image of a medieval defensive tower with a steep conical roof and machicolations, flanked by scenes of ornate historic buildings, an old-town street, parked vintage cars, and a park lake with a rowboat. The front has a red band labeled "SIBIU." The reverse shows a standard Romanian layout with price and publisher marks.
